extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers / novelists working on endings
extracted.subtask_description: Advice and actionable criteria for crafting the resolution/denouement of a novel so readers feel satisfied; covers what a resolution must accomplish and stylistic choices for final lines or scenes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of denouement / resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: The final part of a play, movie, or narrative in which the strands of the plot are drawn together and matters are resolved (denouement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where the climax is the peak of action, the resolution/denouement are the last beats of the story revealing the wrap up or closure to the characters and plot lines. Use this as the working definition when crafting the ending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfying ending (overall objective)
rubrics_metrics.description: No matter if the resolution is happy, sad, or bittersweet — the goal is a SATISFYING ending.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for emotional and narrative satisfaction rather than a particular tone; use the following concrete criteria and stylistic choices to achieve that satisfaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wraps up the major beats of the story
rubrics_metrics.description: The resolution should wrap up the major beats of the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure principal plotlines are drawn to a conclusion so the reader doesn't feel loose threads remain; prioritize the major over every minor subplot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offers closure for the main character(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: The resolution should offer closure of the main character(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show how the character's arc has finished or moved to a new, stable state—this delivers emotional payoff and signals completion of the journey.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provides interpretive framing for the reader
rubrics_metrics.description: The resolution should provide a way for the reader to interpret the events of the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Help readers make sense of what happened—themes, consequences, or meaning—so the ending feels purposeful rather than arbitrary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Main character has learned what they needed to learn
rubrics_metrics.description: The main character has learned what he needed to learn on the journey.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate growth or an internal change that justifies the arc; this is a common route to emotional satisfaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hero saves others (external payoff)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero is able to save others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resolve stakes not only for the protagonist but for others affected by the story; this can reinforce heroism and consequence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story comes full circle
rubrics_metrics.description: The story comes full circle — we see the circle of life in action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Return to motifs, locations, or images from the opening to give structural unity and the sense that the narrative has completed a loop.

rubrics_metrics.name: Redemption occurs
rubrics_metrics.description: Redemption happens for main character, side character or a portion of society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use redemption arcs to provide moral or emotional resolution; redemption can be partial or complete but should feel earned.

rubrics_metrics.name: End on a great piece of dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: Finish the book with a strong piece of dialogue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A memorable line of speech can crystallize character and theme as a final beat; choose dialogue that resonates and feels like a natural closing.

rubrics_metrics.name: End on an image (bookend image)
rubrics_metrics.description: End on an image — could be a bookend image that reflects back to the opening image.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A striking visual can echo the opening and give the novel structural symmetry; use sensory detail to leave a lasting impression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use an epilogue
rubrics_metrics.description: After the final scene you may want to give your audience a tidbit about what happens to the characters after your ending.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An epilogue can provide additional closure or show consequences further downstream; keep it brief and purposeful so it enhances rather than dilutes the ending.

rubrics_metrics.name: End on a great piece of prose
rubrics_metrics.description: End with a strong piece of prose that sums things up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authorial summation can give readers a full view of closing moments; use voice and craft to leave readers emotionally satisfied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a cliffhanger only for series-readiness (answer big questions)
rubrics_metrics.description: A cliffhanger is usually utilized when an author intends to write a series — or already has the next one written.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers will feel ripped off if the major questions of your novel are not answered. Make sure to answer the big questions and leave only one lingering, intriguing question to drive interest in the next volume. (Remember — your goal is a satisfied reader.)

rubrics_metrics.name: End with a quote (if thematically appropriate)
rubrics_metrics.description: End with a meaningful quote, especially if you have utilized quotes throughout your book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A quote can feel natural and thematically resonant if integrated into the book's structure; avoid shoehorning a quote that doesn't align with voice or theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: End with a question (use cautiously)
rubrics_metrics.description: End with a question — this is a dangerous one; it could be powerful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only use a question if the reader is already satisfied and the question feels humorous or organic to your writing style; otherwise it can leave readers frustrated.
